screens.title: Select files
screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished, high fidelity product design concept image for Audioframe, a browser app that turns local audio and artwork into landscape music videos. Flat front-on digital UI artwork, no physical desk/device photography or tilted perspective. Large landscape canvas, razor-sharp readable UI typography. Follow the existing design system: white and warm off-white surfaces, near-black text, thin pale-gray borders, rounded cards, generous spacing, teal #08758B primary actions, deep midnight #071b24 media preview, aqua audio-reactive accents. Space Grotesk-style headings, IBM Plex Sans-style UI text. Logo: small teal rounded square containing a white outlined frame and five vertical waveform strokes; wordmark Audioframe. Minimal restrained thin line icons. Example project is "A moment in colour" by "Your Artist", album "Night Studies", duration 3:42, abstract teal artwork. This is a planned v0 UI concept, not a screenshot of implemented features. Small "V0 CONCEPT" label outside the app in the upper margin. No account/login, cloud upload, YouTube, social sharing, high-resolution choices, auto transcription, automatic lyric timing, invented cloud library, pricing or backend details. Local media never uploads. Landscape output fixed at 568 × 320 and 30 fps. Each requested app screen must show plausible actionable controls; hierarchy and clarity matter more than dense copy.
Asset type: desktop file-selection screen and action detail. Compose one large desktop app screen taking about 85% of the page, with a slim annotation strip below. Header logo left, tiny "Files stay on your device" badge right. Three-step navigation: "1 Files" active, "2 Create", "3 Export". Heading "Start with your sound." Subheading "Choose a track and its artwork." Two beautiful side-by-side file cards: Audio card selected with filename "a-moment-in-colour.mp3", "3:42 · 8.4 MB", small waveform and playback controls, "Replace audio" button; Artwork card selected showing teal abstract square image, filename "cover.png", and "Replace artwork". Below show supported formats in small readable labels: "Audio: MP3, M4A, WAV, MP4 · Up to 7 minutes" and "Artwork: JPG, PNG"; note "MP4 uses its audio track only." Bottom left secondary "Import settings" and helper "JSON settings only. Choose media separately." Bottom right prominent teal "Continue to editor" with right arrow. Annotation strip has three short numbered action chips: "01 Choose audio", "02 Choose artwork", "03 Continue". A separate compact validation example below the main frame says "Track is 8:12. Choose audio up to 7:00." beside a "Choose another track" outlined button. Do not imply uploading. Output one coherent refined visual.

Asset type: a premium four-panel desktop action storyboard for export flow. Landscape 2-by-2 grid of four generous readable app panels. Each panel has same Audioframe header and example project's thumbnail. Outside each panel a clear numbered caption. Panel 1 caption "01 / Choose output". Heading "Export your video", MP4 selected format card with small "H.264 · AAC"; WebM alternate with "VP8 · Opus"; fixed summary "568 × 320 · 30 fps · 3:42"; teal "Export video" button and outlined "Back to editor". Panel 2 caption "02 / Watch progress". Heading "Making your frame", prominent 62% and progress bar; three stages "Prepare" checked, "Render" active, "Finalise" pending; "About 2 min remaining" plus "Estimate" in muted small type. Do not claim successful saving after clicking download; no hosted link. Panel 4 caption "04 / Recover from a failure". Calm warning icon, heading "Export could not finish", helper "Your project is still here. Try exporting again."; "Retry export" teal and "Back to editor" outline. A compact separate inset state "Export cancelled" with "Return to editor". No invented error codes, server retries or background promises. Clear varied states; readable UI, not a dense architecture chart.
